content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-512. - I.P.M.C. Section 305.5, Handrails and guards.
content.summary:
Section 305.5. Handrails and guards,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
305.5. Handrails and guards.
Every handrail and guard shall be firmly fastened and capable of supporting normally
                  imposed loads and shall be maintained in sound condition."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020…
